groups.title: Move Unreal's cache to drive F, and delete the copy on C:
groups.why: Unreal keeps a cache of built shaders and assets (capped at 10 GB on your yes of Tuesday), and an older cache it is draining. Your rule is that caches live on drive F, not C: (F has 31 GB free). On your yes I point Unreal's own settings at the LedgerTools folder on drive F, and once Unreal is closed I delete both old copies on C:.
groups.after: The next build or two are a few minutes slower while the cache refills on F. It stays at 10 GB there.

groups.title: A spare copy of the project a helper left behind
groups.why: A helper I ran on Tuesday worked in its own spare copy of the project, and the copy stayed. Everything in it is on GitHub; nothing uses it. I no longer run helpers that way.

others.name: Dropbox
others.why: yours; the backup adds to it and never deletes

others.name: Windows' hibernation file
others.why: the biggest win and yours alone: a Windows setting I may not change. If you never hibernate the PC, run 'powercfg /h off' in a terminal opened as administrator and it goes, putting C: over 60 GB with the rest
